name: Christi Burgess Haswell
occupation: Sheridan County commissioner and board chairperson (re-elected November 2026)
prior_offices: Sheridan County commissioner (listed as chairperson on the official commissioners page; Sheridan Media reported she was one of three commissioners elected in the November 2026 general election)
background: Christi Haswell is chairperson of the Sheridan County Board of Commissioners and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official commissioners page lists her as chairperson. Sheridan Media reported that she, Holly Jennings, and Jim Schellinger were the three candidates elected to the commission in that election.
